posts.caption_fb: Twenty years on, the sambar recipe in the kitchen is still amma's. Toor dal, drumstick, tamarind, the masala she ground every Sunday in our Kochi kitchen. Aditi keeps it the same way — that's the whole point of the place.
posts.caption_ig:
Twenty years on — the sambar in the kitchen is still amma's recipe.

Toor dal · drumstick · tamarind.
The masala she ground every Sunday in our Kochi kitchen.

Aditi keeps it the same way.
posts.image_brief: Aditi's hands grinding masala in a stone mortar, or stirring a pot of sambar on the stove. Hands only — no face. Soft side light. Authentic, not styled.
